name: 11367 · Flushing, NY
findings: ZIP 11367 (Flushing) has 213 nonprofit organizations. 50 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 41 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11367 (Flushing) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
96% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: No social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 9 would.
